description: Native-format error-path fixtures (design 3.1, 3.2, 5.2). Data only: the MaesterTest attribute type is not loaded here. Each entry maps a fixture ID to the expected 3.0 Result and ReasonCode from the 5.2 contract table. designSpecified=false marks a case the table does not cover; the expectation is a proposal to confirm.

fixtures.title: Returns $null with no skip and no -Investigate
fixtures.rule: returns `$null` with no skip and no `-Investigate`

fixtures.title: Returns a string instead of a boolean
Leaks ArrayList.Add output before returning $true
fixtures.rule: returns more than one object (an unassigned method result leaks into the output)

fixtures.title: Method call on $null, then returns $true
fixtures.rule: any terminating error: a statement-terminating error ends the test because the engine wraps the call in try/catch (5.2); must not be Passed

fixtures.title: Write-Error (non-terminating), then returns $true
fixtures.rule: returns `$true`; the non-terminating error is stored in Diagnostics and re-emitted on the error stream. The engine sets its own ErrorActionPreference, so a caller's Stop does not turn it into a terminating error
expectedDiagnostics: One user could not be read; continuing.

fixtures.title: -SkippedBecause NotApplicable with no return after it
fixtures.rule: `-SkippedBecause <code>`: the call ends the test. The line after it is the ORCA `return = $null` typo, which would error if reached

fixtures.title: Skip raised inside the test's own try/catch
fixtures.rule: `-SkippedBecause <code>`; the skip survives the test's own boilerplate catch through the helper's re-throw guard (5.2). ResultDetail.TestSkipped keeps the legacy code NotConnectedExchange

fixtures.title: break at the top level of the function
fixtures.rule: not in the 5.2 table. A break outside a loop unwinds to the nearest enclosing loop, which would be the engine's run loop; the engine must contain it and report the test as an error. Proposed

fixtures.title: exit inside the test function
fixtures.rule: not in the 5.2 table. exit must not end the engine, the run or the host; the engine must contain it and report the test as an error. Proposed

fixtures.title: Sleeps 30 seconds, then returns $true
fixtures.rule: exceeds a configured timeout. Only when Execution.TestTimeoutSeconds is set below 30; with the 3.0.0 default (no timeout) the result is Passed. A deadline that fires is Timeout even though the test later returns $true

fixtures.title: Writes warning, verbose, debug and information records, then returns $true
fixtures.rule: returns `$true`; warning, verbose, debug and information records are merged into the nested output and re-emitted on Invoke-Maester's streams; the warning is also stored in Diagnostics (5.2 Streams)

fixtures.title: -Investigate, then throws
fixtures.rule: order of evaluation (5.2): -SkippedBecause Error; -Investigate; any other skip; an uncaught error; the returned value. -Investigate outranks the uncaught error
